summary: This 6-K filing by Fury Gold Mines Ltd. reports metallurgical test results for its Ninaaskumuwin lithium discovery. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, or restructuring is described; the filing solely presents operational updates on exploration and processing potential for a lithium deposit. The registrant is the issuer filing a routine progress report on mineral testing, with no offer, shareholder vote, or structural change. As a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16, this is a standard regulatory update without deal activity. Therefore, the appropriate classification is 'None'.
